definitions.explanation: To relocate one's home to a different place. Specifically refers to moving house, not just visiting.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{東京|とうきょう}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}します。
examples.english: I'm moving to Tokyo next month.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{準備|じゅんび}をしている。
examples.notes: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し is the noun form

examples.japanese: {何回|なんかい}も{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xに{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す (move to X).

ASPECT: ている indicates completed action with ongoing relevance. {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}している = 'have moved' or 'am in the process of moving.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・Xに{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す (move to X)
・{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し (moving, relocation—noun)
・{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (moving company)
・{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{祝|いわ}い (housewarming gift)
・{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して{来|く}る (move here)

CONTRAST WITH {移|うつ}る:
・{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す: specifically moving residence
・{移|うつ}る: more general 'move/transfer' (residence, job, location)

COMPOUND VERB: {引|ひ}く (pull) + {越|こ}す (cross over) → implies moving belongings over to a new place.
